title: Satellites for trains and farms
titleZh: 服务火车与农场的卫星
summaryZh: 英国航天局公布支持卫星通信项目的计划，包括改善列车网络与帮助农民监测作物。原报道发表于2026年8月18日；本篇是英语同语言分级改写，所述项目目标不代表已经全部实现。
levelReason: 编辑估计 B1：包含目的表达、较长的不定式结构、被动进行时及计划与可能性的区分，卫星通信词汇附中文注释。这不是经认证的 CEFR 测评。

source.name: UK Space Agency / GOV.UK
source.title: Better WiFi on remote trains and access to cutting edge tech for British farmers through £13 million boost to drive next-gen satellite communications
source.author: UK Space Agency; Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade; Baroness Lloyd of Effra CBE（页面 From 栏）

adaptation: 依据 GOV.UK 上英国航天局的英语新闻稿作同语言分级改写，保留计划与预计成果的区别，并配逐句中文翻译。未复用第三方企业代表引语、图片、标志或外链材料；没有将意、法、德语文章翻译后冒充英语原生来源。

sentences.text: Satellites can support everyday services, even in places far from towns.
sentences.zh: 即使在远离城镇的地方，卫星也能为日常服务提供支持。

sentences.text: On 18 August 2026, the UK Space Agency announced support for sixteen projects.
sentences.zh: 2026年8月18日，英国航天局宣布支持16个项目。

sentences.text: The government is investing thirteen million pounds in new satellite communication technology.
sentences.zh: 英国政府正向新的卫星通信技术投入1300万英镑。

sentences.text: Two projects focus on improving train internet and helping farmers monitor their crops.
sentences.zh: 其中两个项目着重改善列车网络，并帮助农民监测作物。

glosses.note: on 后接名词或动词-ing形式

sentences.text: One project will test satellite broadband on Scotland’s West Highland Line.
sentences.zh: 一个项目将在苏格兰的西高地铁路线上测试卫星宽带。

sentences.text: Some parts of this route are hard for ordinary mobile networks to reach.
sentences.zh: 这条线路的部分路段很难被普通移动通信网络覆盖。

sentences.text: The trial aims to give passengers a more reliable connection during their journey.
sentences.zh: 这项试验旨在为乘客提供旅途中更可靠的网络连接。

sentences.text: Another project is developing low-cost sensors for farmers.
sentences.zh: 另一个项目正在为农民开发低成本传感器。

sentences.text: These devices will use satellite links to send up-to-date information about land and crops.
sentences.zh: 这些设备将通过卫星连接，传送有关土地和作物的最新信息。

sentences.text: Farmers could use the data to make better decisions and reduce waste.
sentences.zh: 农民可以利用这些数据作出更好的决策，并减少浪费。

sentences.text: The technology is being designed for rural areas with little or no internet coverage.
sentences.zh: 这项技术正面向网络覆盖不足或完全没有网络的乡村地区进行设计。

sentences.text: Other projects aim to improve communication systems for future missions to the Moon and deep space.
sentences.zh: 其他项目旨在改进通信系统，为未来的月球和深空任务提供支持。
